reviews.summary: Twilight shoot, but the house and garden are edited flat and grey, so it doesn't glow. Needs warmth, brightness and lit windows.
good: Kitchen (25-27) and living areas are straight with windows pulled
Interior verticals are correct

fixes.fix: House, garden and driveway are grey and flat. Lift the exposure and warm them up so the house is the bright, glowing hero. Every window and door should glow warm, and outdoor lights should be on and visible.
Grey shadows everywhere. Bring the brightness of the house and garden up to match the sunset sky. Keep the sky as it is (pink sunset is fine).
Too much HDR: crunchy leaves and grey shadows. Lower clarity and sharpening on the plants and add warmth so the garden looks lit at dusk, not grey.
Remove the power lines across the sky.
Blue and green walls are too saturated. Bring them down so they look like real paint.
Ceilings and tiled floors look grey. Lift and warm the whites slightly.

reviews.summary: Interiors are a good warm premium look, but on the fronts the new sky has leaked into the windows, so the house looks fake.
good: Interiors have the warm cream premium look, with windows pulled
Ocean and balcony views are clear and natural
Verticals straight across the set

fixes.fix: The sky replacement has gone into the windows: the glass is flat cyan with a purple/green sheen instead of real reflections (worst on the big upper-right window in 06267, the balcony doors, and the ground-floor windows in 06262). Remove the new sky from all window and balcony glass and keep the original reflections. Only replace the sky above the roof.

The new sky is too saturated cyan at the top and fades to hazy white at the roofline, so the house looks cut out and pasted on. Use a soft pale-blue sky that matches the real light, the same on both fronts.
Faint ghost cloud outlines in the sky on the left, and a thin magenta line along the top of the gutter. Clean both at 100% zoom.
Dark speckles in the sky next to the trees, and the tree edges look crunchy and over-sharpened. Refine the sky mask and lower sharpening on the foliage.
Same alfresco shot delivered twice. Only deliver one.

reviews.summary: Twilight exteriors are the strongest part. Bedrooms are grey and flat, and one stairwell shot is washed out.
good: Twilight exteriors (28-39) have a warm sunset sky and the house lights glow evenly
Hero front (39) looks premium, with sky showing cleanly through the tree
Kitchen and living shots (6-15) are bright and straight, windows pulled
Theatre room (1-3) keeps its dark ceiling and colour

fixes.fix: Empty bedrooms read cool grey and flat. Warm the white balance slightly and add a little contrast so the walls look clean white, not grey.
Stairwell shot looking up is almost all white with no detail. Bring the highlights down so the walls and pendant lights have shape, or leave this frame out.
Balcony is dark and heavy next to the bright sky. Lift the shadows on the brick and tiles.

reviews.summary: Bright and consistent, but a smeared mirror and sky halos in the trees pull it down.
good: Bright, neutral standard look across the whole set
Windows pulled
No photographer in either bathroom mirror
Verticals straight

fixes.fix: Ragged dark smear along the top edge of the ensuite mirror. Clean it up so the mirror edge is straight and smooth.
White speckle halos through the gum trees after the sky swap. Refine the sky mask round the leaves so no white dots or outlines show at 100%.

reviews.summary: Clean, bright interiors. One exterior still shows bits of the old grey sky.
good: Interiors bright and clean, wall colour true to the paint
Windows pulled with clean security-mesh detail
No photographer in the bathroom mirror

fixes.fix: Original grey-white sky still showing between the branches, top left and right. Replace it so blue sky fills every gap.
Faint white outlines round the palm fronds. Refine the sky mask.
Near-identical to DSC09024, DSC09068 and DSC09079. Only deliver one of each.

reviews.summary: The sky swap is messy and the house doesn't glow enough.
good: Interiors clean and bright
Pool frames acceptable

fixes.fix: White speckle halos in the palms and orange halos on the trees along the horizon. Refine the sky mask and check at 100%.
Sunset sky on one side, original grey sky behind the trees on the other. Use one sky across the whole frame.
Flat cream-grey sky. Replace it with a proper sunset sky from the Twilight picks folder.
Ghosted white diagonal streak through the tree. Remove it.
Only 2 windows and the door are lit and the garage is dark. Make every front window and the door glow evenly and warm. The door glass looks flat yellow.

reviews.summary: Good warm glow on the house, but the sky swap leaves halos round the trees.
good: Front windows and pergola lights warm and even
Garden and alfresco lights clean
Interiors bright and neutral

fixes.fix: On the city view the tree tops look melted, with blue halo outlines. Redo the sky mask round the trees.
White and blue halos round the gum leaves, and old grey sky left inside the canopy. Fill every gap in the canopy with the new sky.
The upper sky is washed out grey-white. Use a sky with more colour at the top so the frame doesn't look faded.

reviews.summary: Clean and neutral, a clear step up. Interiors need more depth and the alfresco needs work.
good: Whites are clean white, no grey-blue cast
Window pulls excellent on every frame, no halos
Kitchen and living shots (19-24) are the strongest in the set
Front exteriors (27-29) have the right soft pale-blue sky

fixes.fix: Rooms look flat: white walls, white ceiling, dark floor and not much in between. Add mid-tone contrast and a little clarity so the rooms have depth.
Alfresco sky is hazy and washed out. Replace it with the same pale-blue sky as the front shots.
Hard sun stripes across the concrete pull the eye. Soften the highlights.

reviews.summary: Straight and bright, but the whole set is cold and grey. Needs warmth and depth.
good: Verticals straight and compositions clean
Window pulls natural, garden visible, no halos
Exterior skies (12-14, 23, 24) soft pale blue

fixes.fix: Walls read blue-grey and the rooms feel cold. Warm the white balance about +200K so whites are clean and slightly warm.
Ensuite is almost black-and-white. Bring back the real tile colour, add warmth and some contrast.
Sun patch on the floor is close to blown. Pull the highlights down until the floor texture shows.
Ceilings are flat and washed out. Keep some tone in them.

reviews.summary: Clean pass. This is the standard every job should hit.
good: Bright, neutral look consistent across the set
Light-blue sky on the fronts, clean edges at 100%
No reflections in the gilt mirror or vanity mirrors
Windows pulled

fixes.fix: Near-identical to DSC05773 (dining). Only deliver one.
